candidates.title: Neural Nearest Neighbors Networks
candidates.source_core: Learn distances and temperature; recursively form multiple neighbor distributions, updating logits by log(1-p) after each selection; retain separate neighbor volumes and their differences from the query.
candidates.transfer: Use projected Local plus active role/head tokens as the within-utterance set. Exclude self, produce three relaxed neighbor volumes per query, concatenate query and three neighbor-minus-query vectors, decode token corrections through zero-initialized output maps. No cross-utterance database.
candidates.implementation: At each of three ranks: p=softmax(logits); neighbor=p@values; logits+=log1p(-p.clamp(max=1-eps)). Keep ranks separate, rather than summing them into one attention result. Positive bounded learned temperature; no batch normalization or random sampling.
candidates.substantive_difference: Recursive relaxed selection without replacement and separate ordered neighbor volumes, rather than hard kNN EdgeConv, a single weighted average, or transport to a reference bank.
candidates.mask: Only active tokens enter distance normalization. Existing input wrapper handles empty history, first utterance, padding and inactive slots.
candidates.risk: Feature-space neighbors may not correspond to useful sentiment evidence; temperature saturation can reduce gradient quality. Selection ranks are proximity ranks, not temporal order.

candidates.title: PointCNN: Convolution On X-Transformed Points
candidates.source_core: Neighborhood relative coordinates generate a dense K-by-K X transformation; lifted coordinates and features are transformed jointly before separable neighborhood convolution.
candidates.transfer: Learn an eight-dimensional feature chart for Local and active role/head tokens. For each token use four nearest active chart neighbors, lift relative chart coordinates, generate the dense X matrix, mix neighbor features, then apply channelwise neighbor kernels and a pointwise channel map. Compose two X-conv blocks, then zero-initialized token correction decoders.
candidates.implementation: Preserve the source three-stage X generator: flattened neighborhood-to-K*K projection followed by two rowwise K-to-K transformations, last linear; coordinate lift uses two affine/ELU layers. No image grid or hardcoded head adjacency. Keep token role/head embeddings.
candidates.substantive_difference: Dense neighborhood canonicalization followed by separable contraction, not EdgeConv max pooling or invertible coupling. Learned chart is an explicit adaptation, not source 3D geometry.
candidates.mask: Select neighborhoods from active tokens only; fixed K=4 is feasible with Base's eight forward heads even for ATV. Existing wrapper bypasses absent history and remasks inactive outputs.
candidates.risk: Chart neighborhoods and latent canonicalization are hypotheses; no spatial or rotation-invariance claim. Hard neighbor membership has piecewise gradients. This is an adapted X-conv block, not a PointCNN benchmark reproduction.

not_counted.reason: Source and paper checked, but spectral-normalized residual MLP alone does not meet this request's substantive-block threshold; invertibility is not needed by the proposed readout.
Iterative author code checked, but full paper retrieval was blocked and distinction from existing repeated attention/equilibrium routes needs stronger grounding; not counted.
